facts.related_party_note: The company has related party transactions with its wholly owned subsidiaries (Evagrace Pharma Private Limited, Ritz Formulations Private Limited, Sungrace Pharma Private Limited, Azillian Healthcare Private Limited), subsidiary (Calborn Lifescience Private Limited), joint venture (Medico Lab), key management personnel, independent and non-executive directors, relatives of key management personnel, and enterprises over which key management personnel exercise significant influence (Medico Healthcare, Oxford Pharma, Flora Marketing, Kingston Infracon, Kingston Café). Transactions include purchase/sale of goods, rent/vehicle hire charges, interest received, and loans given/repaid.
